release.content: pubkit 0.41.0 was released on 2026-11-16 from commit 1653e331e30a2e7ed0cf01d2cc2f362955f617cc with these changes.

rows: sync --check holds every repository but a content one to the Gherkin rule, and `pubkit gherkin` runs it alone: TEST-01 a feature file with a scenario, TEST-02 no test outside a scenario (plain pytest functions and classes, unittest, Node test files, test shell scripts; Rust's own tests stay), TEST-03 every feature file bound; declared exceptions with an until date waive a rule; `pubkit init` seeds a first scenario

The Gherkin check reads a Node file that loads @cucumber/cucumber, quickpickle or @amiceli/vitest-cucumber as steps, even when it also loads node:test's mock, and counts such a runner in any package.json of the repository (a package's too) as running every feature file; a shell script named *.test.sh is a test too
